info.title: Lychee Reverse Geo Coding
info.description: Self-hosted reverse geocoding service exposing a Nominatim `/reverse`-jsonv2-compatible endpoint, backed by data embedded in the binary via authenticvision/rgeo (Natural Earth country/province/city polygons). No outbound network calls, no rate limits, no API key.

get.description: Resolves a latitude/longitude pair to country/province/city level detail. Mirrors the subset of Nominatim's `/reverse?format=jsonv2` contract that geocoder-php/nominatim-provider (used by Lychee) reads.

parameters.name: zoom
parameters.description: Detail level, 0-18 (default 18). zoom < 10 drops city, zoom < 6 also drops province/state. rgeo never resolves finer than city, so higher zoom values return the same detail as 18.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Accepted for Nominatim compatibility; the response is always jsonv2-shaped.

parameters.name: addressdetails
parameters.description: Accepted for Nominatim compatibility; the address object is always included.

200.description: A resolved location, or a Nominatim-style `{"error": ...}` body if the coordinate isn't within range of any landmass (e.g. open ocean).

value.licence: Data from naturalearthdata.com (public domain), reverse geocoded locally by rgeo. Not affiliated with or sourced from OpenStreetMap.

200.description: The OpenAPI 3.0 spec for this service.

Address.description: Fields Nominatim would return but rgeo cannot resolve (road, house_number, postcode, suburb, ...) are always omitted.

place_id.description: Deterministic id synthesized from the resolved location, stable across repeated lookups of the same place.

boundingbox.description: [south, north, west, east], approximated around the query point since rgeo doesn't expose the matched polygon's extent.
